calculation.description: Ranks 20-session lagged trend after volatility scaling. During elevated cross-asset median volatility, attenuates trend strength and adds a modest low-risk preference. Stress threshold is the lagged rolling 70th percentile of the 10-session median cross-sectional volatility over a 252-session window. All inputs are lagged to avoid look-ahead.
